subject: Onramp timetable and decision triggers for FluxOS POC
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Julie Park <julie@fluxos.com>, Samir Desai <samir@fluxos.com>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Mar 2028 15:04:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap + proposed onramp timetable (FluxOS)

Julie / Samir — thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have a single place to move from discovery into an actionable POC. TL;DR: Redwood can deliver the evaluation surface you asked for; confirm kickoff week and we’ll schedule the weeklies.

Key goals (what success looks like)
- Inference latency <= 200ms p95 on your peak query profile (50 concurrent threads)
- Reduction of per-token cost by >= 30% vs current host baseline (measured across 3 representative prompts)
- Integration viability: native REST calls to your staging platform + a working prefix cache for the top 10 prompts

Proposed POC onramp/timeline (draft)
- Week A (Mar 15): Kickoff + environment access + baseline profiling
- Weeks 1–3 (Mar 16–Apr 5): Integration + workload tuning + weekly syncs
- Week 4 (Apr 6): Midpoint demo + decision checkpoint
- Weeks 5–6 (Apr 7–Apr 26): Final tuning, acceptance tests, readout (final readout Apr 26)

Owners we suggest
- Redwood: Hannah Schmitt (ops/config), Ben Carter (commercial & timeline), Eng on call for provisioning
- FluxOS: Julie Park (product owner), Samir Desai (platform/infra)

Attachments: FluxOS_POC_MAP_v1.xlsx (mutual action plan draft) — I attached milestones, deliverables, and checkbox acceptance criteria.

Open items / asks for you
1) Confirm kickoff week (we suggested W/C Mar 15).
2) Share staging credentials and CORS/API allowlist for our test agents (a simple ip allowlist or temporary key works).
3) Confirm the three representative prompts you want included in the cost/quality comparison.

If we lock kickoff for Mar 15 I’ll send calendar invites for weekly syncs (30 min) and assign task owners in the MAP.

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com
[Attachment: FluxOS_POC_MAP_v1.xlsx]

From: Julie Park <julie@fluxos.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Desai <samir@fluxos.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Mar 2028 17:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + proposed onramp timetable (FluxOS)

Ben — thanks for the clear recap. We’re aligned on the goals. A few clarifications before we lock dates: 

- The latency target is reasonable; can you confirm whether that p95 includes network latency to our staging region (us-west-2) or is it strictly server-side?
- For the cost comparison, we’ll provide the three prompts. Can Redwood also include a brief note on what quantization/config options you’ll test so our procurement team can pre-evaluate risk?
- We’d like the kickoff to be week of Mar 15 but can do Mar 16 for the initial 45-min sync (we’re heads down on a release on the 15th).

Two asks for Logistics:
1) Please add a short line item in the MAP that lists any data we’ll need to share (logs, sample payloads).
2) Samir requested a copy of any SOC2 / security attestations you rely on for the sandbox (he’s just confirming with our security team).

If you can confirm those, I’ll lock Mar 16 for the kickoff and send calendar invites.

—Julie
Julie Park
Head of Product, FluxOS
julie@fluxos.com
[Inline: FluxOS internal calendar link]

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Julie Park <julie@fluxos.com>, Samir Desai <samir@fluxos.com>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 3 Mar 2028 09:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + proposed onramp timetable (FluxOS)

Julie — great questions. Answers below and a slightly updated timetable in the MAP (attached SOW draft as well):

- Latency: our p95 target is server-side processing time. We’ll include estimated network RTT to us-west-2 in the baseline report so your team sees end-to-end.
- Quantization/config: we’ll test fp16, static int8, and a 4-bit quantized profile; default run will be fp16 with cache enabled. I’ll capture exact kernel/quant settings in the MAP.
- Security attestations: we can share SOC2 summary and our audit contact; for sandbox access we’ll also provide redacted example logs. Samir — we’ll put the SOC2 PDF in the drive link and include a short security checklist for your reviewers.

Updated POC milestones (locked draft)
- Kickoff: Thu, Mar 16, 2028 — 45 min (introductions, access check, acceptance criteria walkthrough)
- Weekly sync: Thursdays 11:00–11:30am PT (Mar 23, Mar 30, Apr 6)
- Midpoint demo: Tue, Apr 5 — working demo + preliminary cost/readout
- Final readout & decision: Fri, Apr 26 — final run, acceptance checks, signoff

Who does what (owners)
- Redwood: Hannah Schmitt — infra & environment provisioning; Ben Carter — timeline & commercial; Marissa Cole — success metrics and acceptance test suite
- FluxOS: Julie — product owner; Samir — staging/infra contacts and procurement reviewer

I attached the MAP (updated) and a lightweight SOW draft for your procurement review: Redwood-POC-SOW-draft.pdf. Confirm kickoff on Mar 16 and I’ll send invites and the weekly calendar.

Best,
Ben
[Attachments: FluxOS_POC_MAP_v1.xlsx, Redwood-POC-SOW-draft.pdf]

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Julie Park <julie@fluxos.com>, Samir Desai <samir@fluxos.com>
Date: Sun, 4 Mar 2028 10:17:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + proposed onramp timetable (FluxOS)

Thanks — I’ll take infra ownership and start provisioning the sandbox as soon as we get staging access. Quick internal notes for Marissa and Ben (forwarding here so FluxOS sees the owner lanes):

- Marissa: can you draft the acceptance test checklist (items, thresholds, smoke tests) by Wed, Mar 8 so we can include it in the MAP? I’ll add environment validation steps (connectivity, TLS, key rotation notes).
- Ben: I’ll need the temporary API key + allowlist from FluxOS and a contact for any IAM questions (Samir listed). Please confirm the kickoff calendar when you send invites.
- Engineering ramp: I’ll ping infra-oncall to allocate a sandbox instance (1 x A100 equivalent for the first two weeks).

Julie / Samir — we’ll outlay the SOC2 summary in the shared drive and include the redacted logs you requested; expect the drive link in the calendar invite. Looking forward to Mar 16 kickoff.

Hannah Schmitt
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
hannah_schmitt@redwood.com
[Attachment: Redwood-POC-SOW-draft.pdf]
